segments.he: אָמַר אַבָּיֵי: לָא קַשְׁיָא, כָּאן בְּעִנְיָן אֶחָד, כָּאן בִּשְׁנֵי עִנְיָנִים.
segments.en: «Abaye said:» It is «not difficult. Here,» where it is inferred from the baraita that two may read one scroll together, it is referring to a case «where» they are reading «one matter» and each is aware of the progress of the other. «There,» in the mishna, where the ruling is that two may not read one scroll together, it is referring to a case «where» they are reading «two» different «matters,» as each is oblivious to the progress of the other and may pull the scroll closer to improve his vantage point.

edges.cueHe: אמר אביי: לא קשיא, כאן בענין אחד, כאן בשני ענינים

positions.claim: two may read together on one matter, not on two different matters
